title: USA course and level script source inventory

source.variant: USA flags: VERSION_US defined; VERSION_JP, VERSION_SH, VERSION_EU, VERSION_CN, NO_SEGMENTED_MEMORY undefined

known_unknowns: Runtime execution of any listed level script is not established by source or the static BOB byte correspondence.
Native level-script VM handler semantics are outside this static inventory.
Symbolic macro preset names are inventoried but not expanded into behavior/model identities.
A general segmented-pointer-to-ROM mapping and all-course ROM asset mapping remain unknown.

sample.method: 4-byte-aligned whole-ROM scan of pinned BOB entry 48-command opcode/length sequence
operands: 25 placements via three local script refs; all 25 linked coordinate/angle tuples independently agree

limits: The BOB script/bank and operand correspondences establish one bounded source-encoded relationship; they do not show observed loader execution or native VM handler semantics.
Segmented addresses are not generally ROM offsets.
This does not map all level assets.
Source macro declarations are not compiled commands or runtime observations.
The scanner retains source lines and nested macro arguments but only records outer command invocations.
USA active declarations are selected; inactive guarded alternatives remain in source array command lists with usa_active=false.
Local script references are expanded recursively for area placement categories. Cycles and unresolved targets are recorded; global functions are inventoried separately.
Macro-object table entries exclude each MACRO_OBJECT_END terminator; symbolic presets are not expanded into actor/model/behavior identities.
C preprocessor and linker evaluation beyond the listed USA flags is not performed; unknown conditions are retained as usa_active=null.
